title: Perceive, Solve, Reason: Progressive Capability Formation in Time Series-LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2610.23521v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can now perceive, describe, and reason about images and audio, yet time series understanding remains underestimated: most work uses LLMs as forecasters and classifiers, reasoning studies are few and narrow, and no suite trains and evaluates the full range of capabilities. In this paper, we build the first such suite, with 337K training and 44K evaluation samples across three progressive capabilities, Perceive, Solve, and Reason, and use it to ask how time series should enter an LLM that must master all three, and in what order. We find that a dedicated encoder is essential: with one, a 4B model surpasses GPT-4o on every perception attribute we test, whereas textualizing the series costs 8--10 points in reasoning accuracy. translated_title: 感知、求解、推理：时间序列-大语言模型中的渐进式能力形成
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）如今已能对图像和音频进行感知、描述与推理，然而对时间序列的理解仍被低估：大多数工作仅将LLM用作预测器和分类器，推理研究稀少且范围狭窄，也没有任何基准套件能够训练和评估全方位的能力。在本文中，我们构建了首个此类套件，包含33.7万条训练样本和4.4万条评估样本，覆盖三种渐进式能力——感知、求解与推理，并借助它探究时间序列应如何输入到一个必须掌握全部三种能力的LLM中，以及训练应遵循何种顺序。我们发现专用编码器至关重要：配备专用编码器后，一个40亿参数的模型在我们测试的所有感知属性上均超越了GPT-4o，而将时间序列文本化会使推理准确率下降8至10个百分点。这些能力彼此递进：按顺序依次学习三种能力优于将相同数据混合训练的方式，并能与使用三倍以上推理数据的纯推理训练相媲美，但前提是……（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该研究构建了首个覆盖感知、求解、推理三种渐进能力的时间序列-LLM训练评估套件，发现专用编码器不可或缺（4B模型感知能力全面超越GPT-4o），且按顺序渐进式学习三种能力优于数据混合训练，可匹敌使用三倍以上推理数据的纯推理训练。
en_tdlr: This paper builds the first suite (337K training and 44K evaluation samples) for training and evaluating the progressive Perceive, Solve, and Reason capabilities in time series-LLMs, showing that a dedicated encoder is essential—a 4B model surpasses GPT-4o on all perception attributes—and that progressive ordered training outperforms data mixing and rivals reasoning-only training with over three times the reasoning data.
